# Offline fixtures

These are synthetic/deidentified responses for exercising failure cases. They are not a colony or gameplay evidence. The area fixture preserves the shape and dimensions of an observed large-output guard. The health fixture preserves the distinction between a rounded summary and an exact tooltip.

Tests never replay a log into RimWorld. HTTP tests use an injected in-memory opener and control tests use an injected fake MCP client; they do not bind a local port or contact the live endpoint.
